text: 金十数据7月31日讯，中创智领公告，拟以不低于人民币3亿元（含）且不超过人民币4亿元（含）回购公司A股股份，回购价格不超过21元/股（含）。本次回购的A股股份，50%用于注销并减少公司注册资本，50%用于在未来实施股权激励/员工持股计划。回购资金来源为公司自有或自筹资金，回购期限为自公司股东会审议通过回购方案之日起12个月内。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, July 31: Zhongchuang Zhiling announced plans to repurchase its A-share shares for no less than RMB 300 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 400 million (inclusive), with a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 21 per share (inclusive). Of the A-share shares repurchased this time, 50% will be cancelled to reduce the company's registered capital, and 50% will be used for future equity incentives/employee stock ownership plans. The repurchase funds will come from the company's own or self-raised funds, and the repurchase period is 12 months from the date the shareholders' meeting approves the repurchase plan.
